description: This is a Flutter widget file defining the HomeScreen, a stateless widget that displays a grid of recipe cards. It uses Provider for state management and builds a UI with an AppBar, a loading indicator, and a decorated grid view of recipes fetched from the provider.

classes.name: HomeScreen
classes.description: A stateless widget that builds the home screen UI for browsing recipes, using Provider for state management, featuring a grid view of recipe cards.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the HomeScreen, displaying a loading indicator or a decorated grid of recipes depending on the provider state.
